_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd unturned/egg-unturned.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence); picked over Assetto Corsa, whose egg needs a logged-in Steam account. Octail adds the unturned tag, a reserved query port (game port + 1), generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), a broadcast command, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". The token is optional and write-only: without one (or with Server Listing = LAN) the server starts as a LAN server instead of an Internet one; `-GSLT` and `-Password` are passed only when set, an optional max players goes into Commands.dat before every start; **install script fixed**: fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server, links made idempotent.
name: Unturned
author: parker@parkervcp.com
description: Vanilla Unturned with the included RockerMod.
startup: if [ "${SERVER_LISTING}" = LAN ]; then UT_MODE=LanServer; elif [ -z "${GSLT}" ]; then UT_MODE=LanServer; echo "Octail: no Game Server Login Token is set, so the server starts in LAN mode (not on the Internet server list). Create a token for app 304930 at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers and put it in Game Server Login Token on the Startup tab."; else UT_MODE=InternetServer; fi; UT_CMDS="Servers/${SRV_ID}/Server/Commands.dat"; if [ -n "${MAX_PLAYERS}" ]; then mkdir -p "Servers/${SRV_ID}/Server"; if [ -f "${UT_CMDS}" ] && grep -qi '^maxplayers ' "${UT_CMDS}"; then sed -i -E "s/^[Mm][Aa][Xx][Pp][Ll][Aa][Yy][Ee][Rr][Ss] .*/MaxPlayers ${MAX_PLAYERS}/" "${UT_CMDS}"; else echo "MaxPlayers ${MAX_PLAYERS}" >> "${UT_CMDS}"; fi; fi; ./Unturned_Headless.x86_64 -batchmode -nographics -bind 0.0.0.0 -port {{SERVER_PORT}} $( [ -z "${GSLT}" ] || printf -- '-GSLT %s' "${GSLT}" ) -Name "{{SRV_NAME}}" $( [ -z "${SRV_PW}" ] || printf -- '-Password %s' "${SRV_PW}" ) +${UT_MODE}/{{SRV_ID}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'


## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "The SteamCMD download failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## add below your custom commands if needed

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/Unturned_Headless.x86_64 ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Unturned dedicated server. Check the lines above, then reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

## Specific to Unturned
cd /mnt/server/
ln -sfn ../../../steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so Unturned_Headless_Data/Plugins/x86_64/steamclient.so
[ -d Extras/Rocket.Unturned ] && [ ! -e Modules/Rocket.Unturned ] && ln -s ../Extras/Rocket.Unturned/ Modules/

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (up to 50 characters).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = no password. One word: no spaces or quotes.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: A Steam Game Server Login Token for app 304930 (Unturned), made at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers with the Steam account that owns the server. An Internet server needs one to be listed; without one the server starts in LAN mode. Write-only once saved.

variables.name: Server Listing
variables.description: Internet: on the Internet server list (needs a Game Server Login Token; without one the server falls back to LAN). LAN: not listed on the Internet list, no token needed.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Optional: the most players online at once, written to MaxPlayers in the server's Commands.dat before every start. Empty = Commands.dat decides (Unturned's default is 8).

variables.name: Server ID
variables.description: ID of the server for savegames

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam App ID require for install and startup update

variables.name: ld lib path
variables.description: This is needed to load specific libraries

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Unturned always uses the game port + 1 for Steam queries. Octail reserves it when the server is created; the game doesn't read this setting.
